game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow, a meadow of fireflies: the beast tamer must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the elder's door.
theme: Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow: a meadow of fireflies
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Keywords and identifiers: build a valid C source file that prints 9. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the router at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 1 and lower path on row 5. IF item value >= 7, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output. Deliver exactly 8 components (4 upper, 4 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 8.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pattern Painter' (Week 5 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Firefly Meadow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Mystic Forest

source_player_objective: Collect 180 points of acorns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
